title: Explorer v2 orchestrator artifacts (run config, stage records, per-stage summaries, agent task)

relPath.description: Path relative to the run output directory or the repository root, forward slashes, no parent segments.

image.description: Image override (ref@sha256:digest) given with --image or MATTERMOST_PILOT_IMAGE; absent means the target's pin.

metrics.description: Exactly the record that bakeoff/metrics.mjs appends to a result set (cost.stages).

coverage_index_schema.description: Sample check of the extractor records against schemas/coverage-index.schema.json; informational.

coverage-report.description: Output of v2/index/coverage-check.mjs runCheck, kept as evidence.

context.description: Inline task details for a role that needs more than input files (the independent verifier).

delivery.description: Present for --verifier=process: the byte-exact, hash-bound delivery of the two input artifacts.

fixture_attempts.description: Fingerprint of the bookmark ids per stage-0 attempt (hashes only); different fingerprints mean different fixtures.
